Redragon K1NG M724 42G Ultra-Lightweight Wired Gaming Mouse - Black (12400 DPI)

Experience next-level pro performance and unmatched swiftness with the Redragon K1NG M724 42G Ultra-Lightweight Wired Gaming Mouse in its sleek Black Edition. Available at Turbo Computer, this high-performance wired hardware component is masterfully crafted for esports athletes who demand extreme accuracy, zero input lag, and absolutely no physical drag. Weighing at an incredibly light 42 grams, it stands as the definitive choice for competitive FPS players across Egypt looking for an immediate hardware modification to maximize tactical aiming speeds.

The Redragon K1NG M724 Black features a high-efficiency optical gaming sensor, achieving an accurate resolution layout up to 12400 DPI for flawless target tracking. Featuring a reliable, ultra-flexible wired USB connection combined with a highly stable 1000Hz polling rate environment, it delivers instantaneous layout response times without worrying about battery life. Complete with durable micro-switches and a premium lightweight black cable, it secures high-tier stable daily hardware performance.
